changes.title: Audio test
items: The pause page has an Audio test button: a two-minute check of how much sound your machine can play, with results to copy for the builders

changes.title: Zoo lighter
items: The zoo opens much faster from the bestiary book: the night under it waits quietly
The zoo draws only the islands you've found, and uses far less graphics memory

changes.title: Jack o lanterns
items: Jack-o'-lanterns at the party: four kinds of carved pumpkins, grinning, grim, surprised and stacked, glowing and casting a little warm light
